Bengali.reason: refers to the dominant script/language of the BD‑op tweets (Bengali script) mentioned only in the data table, not used in experiments

Latin.reason: refers to the Latin alphabet/script used in tweets, not the Latin language

Persian.reason: refers to Persian as part of the Arabic/Persian script column in the data description, only mentioned

Arabic.reason: refers to Arabic as part of the Arabic/Persian script column in the data description, only mentioned

Spanish.reason: refers to Spanish as the language of certain operations (e.g., VE‑op‑A domestic ES) in the data table, without further analysis

Russian.reason: refers to Russian‑original items and the rusentilex lexicon, with affect‑label validation on Russian texts, so the paper studies Russian language data

Turkish.reason: refers to the Turkish military as an example of a foreign state, not to the Turkish language

English.reason: refers to English text used throughout the study (validation, translation, affect labeling), indicating the paper studies English language data
